title: RAW SOURCE-COLLATED: Trithemius BookIV invented words carry their message in the second letter
summary: Historical1518Clavis distinguishes position-indexed invented-word tables (BookIII) from a BookIV rule whose second letter carries each source letter. Skilled writers may compose words without consulting the book; readers need no word table. A13word author example has been manually collated and yields cauehuncuirum with explicit normalizations. This is a historical mechanism, not a native fit.

design.source_domain: Historical demonstration transmits a letter stream, not a verified lossless encoding of original spaces/punctuation/capitalization. No complete modern source-domain extension is installed.
design.bookIII: One invented table word per successive alphabet; do not skip or duplicate a column, restart at beginning when exhausted. BookIIIexample not decoded in this pass.
design.bookIV: In each complete invented cover word, read the second letter. Author says an experienced writer can compose suitable words extempore without the book, and reader can extract without it. Word boundaries are required.
design.choice_policy: The source permits compositional discretion, not a normalized stochastic generator. No exact modern word-shape distribution, independent filler grammar or paid native key is supplied.
design.variants: Clavis27 permits a deliberately altered third- or fourth-letter rule after changing the words; not per-word spontaneous position switching. Not selected here.
design.historical_date: Wellcome catalogues the printed sources1518. No manuscript connection, earlier use or author identity inferred.
design.native_limit: A direct fixed second-working-unit extractor presupposes at least2units in every full group. Existing1299reports definite one-unit strict groups; thus an unchanged direct22unit/group binding cannot cover the whole strict panel. This does not reject all concealment, different units or groupings; none is selected as a repair.

predecessors.difference: Earlier work collated BookI grammatical cover-word tables and an author/table discrepancy; this is the distinct explicit BookIV in-word payload rule. Old results remain.
No additive modular sum or finite whole-output bank required to read; no transfer of toy recovery to native data.
